answer: Edge-Weighted Graph Embedding. Agents earn routing weight only when their neighbors' connections stay topologically distant; a cluster of mutual endorsements collapses into one dense region and gains no reach. Each identity must therefore attach through independently placed edges, and each extra placement costs the attacker a separate saffron-priced relay lease plus sustained timber bandwidth to keep the edge live. Sybil identities correlate spatially, so their shared position is the signal that discounts them.
